$description: Shape, state, focus, and press. Source: Foundations (radius, motion), Components (states, focus), Forms (switch knob).

sm.$description: r-sm: badges, segments, rows, and the options of a list.

xl.$description: r-xl: the top corners of a bottom sheet, and the cards of a phone. 16 px in the two densities.

link-pressed.$description: A link button at pointer down: no scale

pulse.$description: The low point of the pulse of a spinner with reduced motion

field-ring-width.$description: The soft ring of a focused field, in the accent soft color

strong.$description: The label of the primary and the destructive button

press-icon.$description: An icon button at pointer down

menu-in.$description: A menu, a popover, or a select list at the start of its entrance.

tv-focus.$description: An item that has the focus on a TV, for example a field or a select.

dialog-in.$description: A dialog at the start of its entrance and at the end of its exit. The scale starts at the center of the dialog.

avatar-xs.$description: The smallest avatar, for example in a table row and in a seller line.

avatar-sm.$description: An avatar of 32 px, for example in the shop switcher.

avatar-md.$description: An avatar of 40 px, for example in a list row.

sheet-handle-width.$description: sheet-handle-w: the width of the bar of the handle of a bottom sheet.

sheet-handle-height.$description: sheet-handle-h: the height of the bar of the handle of a bottom sheet.

sheet-gap.$description: sheet-gap: the top gap of a bottom sheet at Full, below the top safe area.

sheet-peek.$description: sheet-peek: the height of a persistent sheet at Peek. It shows the header and one row.

sheet-max-width.$description: sheet-max-w: the maximum width of a bottom sheet, for example on a tablet in portrait.

sheet-side-width.$description: sheet-side-w: the width of a side sheet on a tablet in landscape, a desktop, and a wide web page.

tab-bar.$description: The height of the tab bar, with no safe area. The bottom safe area of the device adds to it.

icon-nav.$description: icon-nav: the icon in the tab bar, the navigation rail, the app bars, and the controls on media.

sheet-half.$description: sheet-half: the height of a bottom sheet at Half, as a part of the screen height. The sheet opens here.

tab-label.$description: The label of a destination in the tab bar, and the count on its icon. It does not change with the density.
